resources.string: Your phone is acting as a Pro Controller.
Find it in Settings → About phone → Status information → Bluetooth address. The console is told this address during setup, so enter it before pairing.

1. On the Switch 2 open Controllers → Change Grip/Order and leave that screen open.
2. Tap “Start controller and pair” here and allow the phone to be visible.
3. Accept the pairing request on the phone if one appears.
4. When the status turns green, open the gamepad and press L + R, then A.

Next time, the console only needs to be awake: tap “Reconnect to a paired console”.

One step per line: milliseconds (or frames, e.g. 4f), then what is held. Buttons: A B X Y L R ZL ZR PLUS MINUS HOME CAPTURE UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT LS RS. Sticks: LS(x,y) RS(x,y) from -1 to 1, or LS_UP / LS_DOWN / LS_LEFT / LS_RIGHT. “loop:” marks where repeating starts. “-” holds nothing.
